purpose: A deterministic 50-case end-to-end benchmark plan. Each card will become one fixture containing a resume and one ordinary job description. RoleFit receives only those two inputs; profile references, expected behavior, and answers remain in the harness.

rules.no_manual_scores: The oracle calculates before and after coverage from the actual resume and job requirements.

cards.primary_signal: supported Basic deployment tool omitted from Skills and Experience
cards.resume_blueprint: Use a complete valid Maya resume but remove every Docker reference.
cards.expected: Ask about Dockerized services; accept the profile fact and add it. Match score increases; safety and structure pass.

cards.primary_signal: mixed missing TypeScript, Kubernetes, and GraphQL requirements that the profile does not support
cards.resume_blueprint: Keep Maya's supported backend evidence, but include none of the three unsupported tools.
cards.expected: Questions may be grouped, but all answers are no. No unsupported tool is added; grounding safety passes.

cards.primary_signal: PostgreSQL requirement already supported by schema-design bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include 'Designed PostgreSQL schemas and query improvements' but do not list PostgreSQL in Skills.
cards.expected: Recognize PostgreSQL as covered and do not ask about it.

cards.primary_signal: related Computer Information Systems degree omitted from an otherwise complete resume
cards.resume_blueprint: Omit Education while retaining the other valid core sections and supporting evidence.
cards.expected: Ask for the degree; accept the exact profile education and place it in Education without inventing details.

cards.primary_signal: Education placed before Experience despite complete content
cards.resume_blueprint: Include all core sections, but order them Header, Summary, Education, Experience, Skills.
cards.expected: Repair the core order to Header, Summary, Experience, Education; final structure passes.

cards.primary_signal: supported Preferred cloud experience omitted
cards.resume_blueprint: Remove AWS, ECS, RDS, and CloudWatch from the resume while keeping the research-software roles.
cards.expected: Ask about AWS even though it is Preferred; add only the supported cloud fact.

cards.primary_signal: required professional Python is absent while Java is present
cards.resume_blueprint: Show Maya's Java services and no Python evidence.
cards.expected: Do not infer Python from Java. If asked, decline; no Python claim is added.

cards.primary_signal: researcher-needs requirement covered by a data-quality collaboration bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the bullet about translating researchers' data-quality needs into maintainable tools.
cards.expected: Recognize the collaboration requirement and do not ask again.

cards.primary_signal: Java satisfies a Java, Python, or comparable-language requirement
cards.resume_blueprint: Include Java API and automated-testing bullets but no Python.
cards.expected: Mark the alternative-language requirement covered while still treating the separate Python requirement as unsupported.

cards.primary_signal: older Experience entry lacks dates
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the Galilee Climate Lab role with its facts but omit 2019–2023.
cards.expected: Ask for the exact dates, use the direct profile value, and preserve reverse chronology.

cards.primary_signal: supported Basic dashboard experience omitted
cards.resume_blueprint: Use Noa's valid resume but omit her Tableau dashboard bullet and Tableau skill.
cards.expected: Ask about Tableau; accept and add the released Loop Commerce dashboard fact.

cards.primary_signal: Google Analytics 4 must not automatically become Amplitude
cards.resume_blueprint: List Google Analytics 4, but no Amplitude, Airflow, or dbt evidence.
cards.expected: Ask rather than equating GA4 with Amplitude; decline unsupported tools and add none.

cards.primary_signal: collaboration qualification covered by metric-definition work with product and engineers
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the metric-definition and prioritization bullet but omit the collaboration skill label.
cards.expected: Recognize the collaboration qualification without a question.

cards.primary_signal: A/B-test requirement expressed in resume as checkout and onboarding experiments
cards.resume_blueprint: Rewrite the supported A/B bullet as 'Evaluated checkout and onboarding experiments to guide product changes' and omit the literal A/B label.
cards.expected: Recognize experiment evidence as covering the requirement; do not ask solely because the abbreviation is absent.

cards.primary_signal: name, phone, and email all missing from an otherwise sound resume
cards.resume_blueprint: Omit the Header entirely; retain Summary, Experience, Education, and Skills.
cards.expected: Request direct header fields, restore them from the profile, and pass final structure.

cards.primary_signal: supported data-quality experience omitted only from an older role
cards.resume_blueprint: Keep both roles but remove CityCart's operational-metrics and data-quality-checks bullet.
cards.expected: Ask about the missing operational evidence and add it to the correct older role.

cards.primary_signal: unsupported Basic Looker and Preferred Snowflake tools
cards.resume_blueprint: Show SQL, Tableau, and Python but no Looker or Snowflake.
cards.expected: Ask about both qualification categories as relevant; decline both with no invented claims.

cards.primary_signal: non-technical stakeholder communication covered by cohort-findings bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include 'presented findings to stakeholders' from the CityCart role.
cards.expected: Treat the reporting requirement as covered without asking.

cards.primary_signal: three-year analytics threshold visibly satisfied across two dated analyst roles
cards.resume_blueprint: Show both roles with 2021–2023 and 2023–Present dates.
cards.expected: Recognize the duration requirement as covered and do not ask for earlier experience.

cards.primary_signal: older Experience role shows only a start year
cards.resume_blueprint: Render CityCart as '2021' rather than '2021–2023'.
cards.expected: Ask for the exact missing end date and restore it from the profile.

cards.primary_signal: supported cross-functional risk-management evidence omitted
cards.resume_blueprint: Remove risk registers and dependency management from all Lior resume sections.
cards.expected: Ask about risk and dependency work, then add supported evidence to TransitGrid Experience.

cards.primary_signal: Salesforce administration and SQL investigation are both unsupported
cards.resume_blueprint: Keep Jira and reporting evidence; include neither Salesforce nor SQL.
cards.expected: Do not infer either tool from Jira or Google Sheets; decline any questions about them.

cards.primary_signal: executive status-reporting requirement covered by program-update bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the Jira and Confluence bullet with executive status updates.
cards.expected: Recognize executive reporting as covered without a follow-up question.

cards.primary_signal: dated Experience entries intentionally appear oldest first
cards.resume_blueprint: Place RouteWorks 2020–2022 before TransitGrid 2022–Present.
cards.expected: Restore reverse chronological Experience order without changing facts.

cards.primary_signal: CAPM credential must not satisfy a Scrum Master certification requirement
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the CAPM credential, but no Scrum certification evidence.
cards.expected: Ask or leave the Scrum preference unmet; never relabel CAPM as Scrum Master certification.

cards.primary_signal: supported Preferred budget tracking omitted from an implementation resume
cards.resume_blueprint: Remove budget tracking and purchase-order coordination from the RouteWorks role.
cards.expected: Ask about the Preferred qualification and add the supported older-role fact.

cards.primary_signal: unsupported Workday implementation requirement
cards.resume_blueprint: Use an otherwise strong implementation resume with no Workday reference.
cards.expected: If queried, decline Workday; no Workday experience is created.

cards.primary_signal: vendor and launch-readiness requirement covered by municipal implementation bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include 'Coordinated vendor dependencies and implementation readiness for three municipal customers.'
cards.expected: Recognize the requirement as covered and do not ask for redundant confirmation.

cards.primary_signal: Education entry has degree and institution but no years
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the B.A. and Hebrew University, but omit 2016–2020.
cards.expected: Ask for exact education dates and restore them without altering the degree.

cards.primary_signal: otherwise valid resume has no Professional Summary
cards.resume_blueprint: Include Header, Experience, Education, and Skills in correct order, but no Summary section.
cards.expected: May suggest a summary, but must not reject the resume structurally or invent one.

cards.primary_signal: supported Basic R analysis omitted from both Skills and Experience
cards.resume_blueprint: Remove R and the survey-analysis clause while retaining the research roles.
cards.expected: Ask about R; accept the supported fact and add it in an appropriate section.

cards.primary_signal: unsupported required Python and preferred causal-inference methods
cards.resume_blueprint: Show Dalia's R, surveys, and reporting, but no Python or causal-inference claim.
cards.expected: Do not infer Python from R or causal inference from descriptive statistics.

cards.primary_signal: non-academic research communication covered by actionable-recommendations bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the stakeholder-workshop and research-report bullet.
cards.expected: Recognize report-writing for stakeholders as covered without a question.

cards.primary_signal: M.A. Public Policy satisfies a public-policy, social-science, economics, or related master's requirement
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the M.A. Public Policy entry with its institution and dates.
cards.expected: Mark the degree requirement covered and do not ask Dalia to confirm a different master's degree.

cards.primary_signal: two repairable research terms are misspelled
cards.resume_blueprint: Use a valid resume but spell 'stakeholders' as 'stakeholdres' and 'anonymization' as 'anonymizaton'.
cards.expected: Correct only those spelling errors; final text contains neither typo and retains the full affected bullets.

cards.primary_signal: supported Preferred literature-review experience omitted from an older research role
cards.resume_blueprint: Remove literature reviews from Negev Social Policy Center while retaining the role dates.
cards.expected: Ask about literature reviews and add the supported older-role evidence.

cards.primary_signal: IRB, randomized-trial, and clinical-research requirements are unsupported
cards.resume_blueprint: Keep consent and anonymization evidence but no IRB, randomized controlled trial, or clinical-research claim.
cards.expected: Do not infer formal IRB work from responsible data practices; decline unsupported items.

cards.primary_signal: participant-data requirement covered by consent and anonymization documentation bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the participant-data practices bullet but omit the Ethics skill category label.
cards.expected: Recognize the responsible-data requirement without a redundant question.

cards.primary_signal: qualitative interviewing appears in Skills rather than as an Experience bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include 'qualitative interviewing' in Skills and omit the matching interview sentence from Experience.
cards.expected: Recognize direct skill evidence rather than treating the Skills section as empty of qualification support.

cards.primary_signal: Education entries intentionally ordered oldest first
cards.expected: Restore reverse chronological Education order while preserving both degrees.

cards.primary_signal: supported CRM experience omitted from resume
cards.resume_blueprint: Remove Salesforce from Skills and delete the customer-health bullet's CRM clause.
cards.expected: Ask about Salesforce/customer health; add the supported CarePath fact.

cards.primary_signal: unsupported HubSpot, product analytics, and French communication requirements

cards.expected: Do not substitute Salesforce for HubSpot or English for French; no unsupported claim is added.

cards.primary_signal: onboarding, adoption, and QBR requirement covered by portfolio-ownership bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the CarePath portfolio-ownership bullet and omit the customer-success skill labels.
cards.expected: Recognize customer-lifecycle experience as covered without a question.

cards.expected: Treat the credential as insufficient proof of hands-on CRM experience; ask, then add the supported work fact after confirmation.

cards.primary_signal: customer-success term is misspelled inside an otherwise valid bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Spell 'onboarding' as 'onbaording' in the CarePath bullet.
cards.expected: Correct the spelling while preserving the complete bullet in the preview and final resume.

cards.primary_signal: supported Preferred CSV/SFTP import experience omitted

cards.expected: Ask about the Preferred import experience and add only the supported fact.

cards.primary_signal: REST API integration, SQL validation, and healthcare certification are unsupported

cards.expected: Do not convert file-import coordination into API integration; decline unsupported qualifications.

cards.primary_signal: implementation delivery requirement covered by migration, training, and go-live bullet
cards.resume_blueprint: Include the ClinicConnect implementation bullet with data migration, training, and go-live readiness.
cards.expected: Recognize the delivery requirement as covered without asking.

cards.resume_blueprint: Include the CSV and SFTP import bullet exactly, but omit 'data migration' from Skills.
cards.expected: Recognize migration coordination from the detailed bullet and do not ask again.

cards.resume_blueprint: Include only Amir's name, 'Implementation Specialist', and 'customer onboarding, Salesforce'; omit dates, employer, bullets, Education, and contact details.
cards.expected: Ask only answerable direct questions, never invent missing history, and end as a structure rejection boundary.
